title: Inspirational
slide_intent: Show how to communicate possibility through a person doing something demanding. A reader can see the action that supports the message.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect an encouraging voice to athletic skill and agency.
demonstration: A gymnast in a bright costume extends her arms across a blurred arena background. Two text blocks connect the trait to direct communication and the motivation to try something new.
practical_value: Select an image in which the person’s action supports the message, then give the copy a clear, direct invitation.

content_islands.name: Photographic example
content_islands.spec: Keep the gymnast large at right and preserve the full movement across the image.

content_islands.name: Trait heading
content_islands.spec: Place Inspirational on a red bar at left so the athlete’s face and pose remain visible.

content_islands.name: Meaning and expression
content_islands.spec: Place two concise columns beneath the label, describing the trait and the corresponding communication style.
